title: Proof anchor baseline
description: The append-only baseline that the first `evidence verify --scope chain` under ADR-EVI-0002 writes to `record/proofs/anchor-baseline.json`: one entry per physical proof line under `record/proofs/work`, with its canonical path, its one-based sequence inside that file, the SHA-256 of the line bytes, and the anchor status observed. The `cutoff` is the timestamp of that first verification; a historical declaration may name only lines whose entry was observed at the first verification, so an entry observed after the cutoff is never eligible. A later verification may append entries for lines that were not yet present and may never change or remove an entry.

record.description: The decision record under which the baseline was first written.

cutoff.description: Timestamp of the first verification under ADR-EVI-0002. Fixed at the first write and never changed.

path.description: Canonical repository-relative path of the proof epoch file: forward slashes, no dot segment, no leading slash.

sequence.description: One-based position of the line within its file. The sequence namespace is the file; it never crosses files.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the line bytes between the previous newline and the next newline, exclusive of the newline.

anchor_status.description: Whether a chain entry anchored the line when the entry was observed.

observed_at.description: Timestamp of the verification that appended this entry. Entries written at the first verification carry the cutoff and are eligible for a historical declaration; an entry observed after the cutoff is not.
